title: Flock CEO Addresses Law Enforcement Contracts
excerpt: Flock CEO Garrett Langley stated that the surveillance firm has not terminated contracts with any police departments despite abuse reports.
body_html:
Garrett Langley, the CEO of surveillance company Flock, stated that the organization has not canceled agreements with any law enforcement agencies or police departments.

The clarification comes despite recent reports of misuse regarding the company's technology. According to the CEO, no police department customers have been dropped as clients amid the scrutiny.
